title: Battle of Reval (1602)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Reval (1602)", at revision 1373818495, opens: "The Battle of Reval took place on June 30, 1602, during the Polish–Swedish War (1600–1611) near present-day Tallinn in Estonia." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q775401, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1602 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
